Definition: {sacred (ceremonially or morally); (as noun) God (by eminence), an angel, a saint, a sanctuary}
BiblicalUsage: The holy ones are the watchers who come down from heaven with the decree against Nebuchadnezzar. The saints of the Most High take the kingdom and possess it for ever, when the kingdom and dominion under the whole heaven is given to them.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the holy ones are both the angels who watch and the people God calls His own, and the promise that the saints shall possess the kingdom is the end of the whole book of Daniel. The watchers decree, and the saints inherit, and the end of the vision is not a throne but a people.
